### JWK

JWK is a JSON Web Key.  For server keys (RSA), only kty/n/e/kid/use/alg
are populated.  For client DPoP keys, crv/x/y may also be set.

|-------|------|-------------|----------|
| `kty` | `string` |  | yes |
